title: 'TNB share price up on Kenyir project's outlook
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Tenaga Nasional Bhd's share price rose in early trading on Friday with its Kenyir Hydrogen Hybrid Fuel System (HHFS) project expected to generate a high single-digit equity internal rate of return. As at 9.57 am, TNB's share price rose eight sen to RM12.98 with 889,300 shares traded. According to MBSB Investment Bank (MBSB IB), electricity demand is also expected to remain strong, with growth projected at 5.4 per cent in calendar year 2026. "We continue to view TNB as a key beneficiary and enabler of Malaysia's energy transition, supported by rising regulated grid capex, growing battery energy storage system requirements and sizeable renewable energy opportunities through initiatives such as HHFS. As such, MBSB IB has maintained its "Buy" recommendation on TNB, with an unchanged discounted cash flow (DCF)-derived target price of RM16.31. CIMB Securities Sdn Bhd has also maintained its "Buy" recommendation, with an unchanged DCF-based target price of RM15.90.

title: '石隆门女子遭假贷款群组连环套 汇款3次始觉受骗向警方求助
body: '（古晋3日讯）意图通过网上个人贷款缓解经济，学校保洁掉入网上诈骗陷阱，3次汇款共6400令吉给老千后，老千继续各种理由要求汇款、保洁才如梦初醒被骗并来到石隆门警局报案求助。  上述欺骗案是发生在石隆门警区，受害者是现年40岁来自石隆门甘榜瑟吉邦的女子，在石隆门某间政中任职保洁工作。  受害者是昨午5时15分来到石隆门警局报案求助，商业犯罪调查查案官已着手展开调查工作。  石隆门警区主任莫哈默海德今早向媒体发布有关讯息。  受害者是在9月28在工作地点游览面子书时，看到名为“myringgitcash”的个人贷款广告，并有意申请1万令吉的个人贷款。  受害人点击广告链接填写了申请人的个人信息，随后被添加到一个名为“myringgit10k”的WhatsApp群组。  加入该WhatsApp群组后，受害人与3名自称是群组管理员的人员联系，联系电话号码分别为011-11236641、011-21097126和011-28589136。  在与3个人交涉后，受害人于 9 月 29 日通过“myringgit10k”WhatsApp 群组被告知，其申请的贷款已获批准，并要求投诉人预先支付几笔款项，据称是为了将贷款资金存入受害人的账户。  因此，投诉人向2个不同的账户进行了三笔交易，具体如下：  2026年9月30日，向Muhammad Nurzaidi Bin Nazri名下的Maybank账户（151342200688）汇款1,100.00令吉 2026年10月1日，向Kannan A/L Gagendran名下的Maybank账户（362405001788）汇款2,200.00令吉 2026年10月1日，向Kannan A/L Gagendran名下的Maybank账户（362405001788）汇款3,140.00令吉  付款后，受害人仍被要求支付额外款项，但由于他认为自己受到了欺骗且未收到任何款项，因此没有继续支付并火速来道警局报案求助。

title: 'Make The Edge Malaysia your preferred source on Google
body: '（吉隆坡1日讯）债券收益率上升，拖累银行股普遍下跌，而马银行（Malayan Banking Bhd）（KL: MAYBANK ）股价更是近9个月来首次跌破10令吉。  收益率上升通常对银行不利，因为银行持有的债券价格下跌，导致更大的账面亏损，这会侵蚀资本，并迫使银行在出售时确认损失。银行还需要提高利率以吸引存款人，从而导致融资成本上升。  艾芬黄氏投资银行今日在报告中指出，这将影响银行的短期非利息收入以及资本比率。  马来西亚资产规模最大的银行马银行连续第三天下跌，收盘下跌0.4%，报9.95令吉。联昌国际集团（CIMB Group Holdings Bhd）（KL: CIMB ）和丰隆银行（Hong Leong Bank Bhd）（KL: HLBANK ）各跌逾1%。  大马交易所金融服务指数下跌至10个月以来的最低水平。  本月初，美联储3年来首次加息，导致马来西亚10年期基准国债收益率一度高达4.18%，之后有所回落。  越来越多经济学家预计，国家银行将在11月举行的年度最后一次货币政策评估会议上调高隔夜政策利率（OPR）。  艾芬黄氏指出，收益率上升通常会导致企业债券收益率上升，这也会与银行及其他企业的融资决策挂钩，进而影响银行的手续费收入。  根据该研究机构的分析，马银行和安联银行（Alliance Bank Malaysia Bhd）（KL: ABMB ）拥有最长的债券期限——即债券以现金流形式偿还本金所需的时间，同时也衡量了其对利率变动的敏感性。  与此同时，大众银行（Public Bank Bhd）（KL: PBBANK ）和丰隆银行的期限最短。就资本充足率而言，马银行、兴业银行（RHB Bank Bhd）（KL: RHBBANK ）和联昌国际集团的降幅可能最大，而大众银行和丰隆银行的降幅最小，因为它们的投资组合期限较短。

title: 'ARMY ‘serbu’ Maybank, suasana bertukar macam mini konsert BTS
body: 'SHAH ALAM – Suasana sebuah cawangan bank di sini bertukar seperti ‘mini konsert’ apabila sekumpulan peminat BTS atau ARMY Malaysia menyanyi dan bersorak bersama-sama ketika menunggu giliran mendapatkan kad debit edisi terhad kumpulan popular Korea Selatan itu.   Gelagat peminat berkenaan mencuri perhatian selepas rakaman suasana di hadapan sebuah cawangan Maybank dikongsikan pengguna Threads, Irfanothman, hari ini.   Lebih menghiburkan, seorang pekerja lelaki bank berkenaan turut dilihat melayan gelagat kumpulan peminat terbabit yang menyanyikan lagu BTS beramai-ramai.

title: 'MHC reschedules Deepavali Day matches after public backlash
body: 'This is generated by AI, we welcome feedback.  The public and clubs expressed annoyance over Malaysian Hockey League (MHL) matches scheduled for Deepavali Day, 8 November. Two matches, Terengganu Hockey Team vs Armed Forces and TNB Thunderbolts vs Maybank, were originally set for 8 November. The Malaysian Hockey Confederation confirmed these matches would be rescheduled to 9 November and 14 November, respectively.

title: 'Sanggup beratur sejak 3 pagi, ‘ARMY’ serbu Maybank buru kad debit BTS edisi terhad
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR – Demam BTS kembali mencetuskan fenomena apabila peminat kumpulan K-pop itu sanggup bangun seawal pagi dan beratur berjam-jam di beberapa cawangan Maybank semata-mata mahu mendapatkan kad debit edisi terhad BTS WORLD TOUR ‘ARIRANG’.   Tinjauan menerusi perkongsian pengguna di Threads pada Rabu mendapati barisan panjang mula terbentuk di beberapa cawangan terpilih, termasuk Shah Alam, Mid Valley, Kuantan dan Kuching.   Malah, ada peminat mendakwa sudah berada di lokasi sejak sekitar pukul 3 hingga 4.30 pagi, beberapa jam sebelum operasi bank bermula.

title: 'Maybank Islamic prints ICP
body: 'MALAYSIA: Maybank Islamic printed a one-year Islamic commercial paper (ICP) worth RM300 million (US$73.94 million) on the 24th September 2026. The facility was arranged by Maybank Investment Bank.

title: 'CIMB sees rising odds of BNM rate hike in 1H27
body: 'BANK Negara Malaysia (BNM) is expected to keep the Overnight Policy Rate (OPR) unchanged at 2.75% in November, although the probability of a rate hike in the first half of 2027 is increasing if economic growth remains firm and inflation pressures broaden, according to CIMB Treasury and Markets Research.   “We expect a hold in November, but see rising odds of a 25bps rate hike in 1H27 if growth stays firm and inflation broadens,” CIMB said in a report released today.   The research house viewed BNM’s Sept 3 monetary policy statement as carrying a hawkish tilt, pointing to the removal of the word “appropriate” from its description of the prevailing monetary policy stance, alongside the central bank’s increased vigilance over commodity-driven cost pressures.
